applicable_to: Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS) conference proceedings.
notes: Class is auto-fetched by Tectonic at compile time; no bundled class file needed. Citation style: Springer basic (bibtex, numbered). Macros (\inst{}, \orcidID{}, \titlerunning, \authorrunning, \keywords inside abstract) were cross-checked against Springer's official author-instructions sample (typeinst.tex, ftp.springer.de LNCS latex2e/instruct). Body is a real filled-in illustrative paper (a priority-aware work-stealing scheduler), not the official sample's meta-instructional prose about how to format a paper. Contains 3 real matplotlib-generated figures: p99-latency and throughput line charts (both vs. background load) in Experiments/Results, plus a priority-floor-over-time trace in Proposed Method illustrating the scheduling mechanism itself. Springer_LNCS_Template.pdf is a kept compiled reference render, excluded from get_template_files like all PDFs. Verified to compile cleanly with zero Overfull/Underfull warnings.
